root_cause_groups.finding: Current main can delete/create a Space, factory-restart a Space, or force-push an external Space repository using HF_TOKEN.

Current main exposes manual or push-triggered workflows that upload models, deploy Cloudflare Workers, mutate Databricks workspaces, sync Hugging Face Spaces or propagate secrets. A self-entered YES input is not a protected-environment approval.
Current main accepts a PAT as a workflow input and interpolates it into a shell command, self-upgrades code with write credentials, and commits resolver output to main.

Current main schedules or push-triggers workflows that write generated telemetry, metrics or research outputs directly to main; the Cognitive PingPong workflow writes placeholder 'Optimal'/'High' status claims without measurement evidence.

proposed_controls: Each listed workflow retains only a discoverable workflow_dispatch stub.
Each listed workflow has permissions: {} and a job-level if: false.
No workflow secret references remain in the quarantined stubs.
No schedule, push or workflow_run trigger remains.
The stubs state that no credentials are read and no repository or external mutation is performed.
The prior self-upgrade workflow test is changed to assert quarantine; script-level unit tests remain in place.
YAML syntax coverage is expanded to all 19 quarantined workflow files.
The existing core CI explicit test list is extended to include the two new quarantine test modules.

residual_risks_not_changed.risk: Core agent runner retains contents:write, pull-requests:write and issues:write. Issue-label invocation is restricted to Barrot-Agent or repository_owner; manual workflow_dispatch remains available to authorized dispatchers. Its schedule-handling code is unreachable because no schedule trigger is declared. This workflow was not disabled because it is the current PR-producing execution path; it requires a separate least-privilege and branch-only-write review.
Manual workflow creates a public issue and pushes memory directly to main. It needs an artifact/PR-only output path or an explicit protected approval mechanism.
Manual workflow reads HF_TOKEN and pushes generated_images to main. It needs artifact/PR-only output or protected approval.
Manual workflow uses GROQ_API_KEY and pushes generated subagent records to main. It needs branch/PR or artifact output before unattended use.
Manual workflow applies an 'approved' label and posts a comment; this is not a GitHub review and does not itself merge. The actual merge queue is proposed disabled; keep this distinction explicit.
The job only prints a status message but grants pull-requests:write; permission can be removed in a separate least-privilege patch.
Observed read-only permissions and artifact-only evidence path; retain, subject to exact-SHA validation.
